name_input: M/S TEREX INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; Terex India Private Limited; TEREX INDIA PVT LTD; TEREX INDIA PRIVATE LIMTIED; TEREX INDIA PVT LTD; TEREX INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; TEREX INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; Terex India Private Limited; Terex India Private Limited; TEREX INDIA PVT LTD; Terex India Private Limited; Terex India Private Limited; TEREX INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug 'terex-india-private-limited', the populated variant; 'terex-india-pvt-ltd' returned an empty shell): 'Total Shipments 31906 Records detected', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28', 'Most recent record'. Exact row quoted: '2026-02-28 | TEREX INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | TSHERING STONE AND AGGREGATE | REARFOOTPAD- | CHAMURCHI INCHMB, India | SAMSTE BHUTAN, BRUNEI | 84749000 | 1120941' — i.e. export from India (Chamurchi land port) to Bhutan, B/L 1120941, dated 2026-02-28. Second quoted row: '2026-02-28 | TEREX INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | TEREX MALAYSIA SDN BHD | CYLINDRICALROLLER BEARING 2410-9008- | BANGALORE ICD INWFD6, India | WestportPort Klang, MALAYSIA | 84829900 | 1138224'. Buyer-side counterparties listed with shipment counts: 'TEREX (THAILAND) LIMITED 702', 'TEREX THAILAND LIMITED 613', 'RUGGED EQUIPMENT LIMITED ... NAIROBI 24141-00502 KENYA 571', 'TEREX GLOBAL GMBH. 582', 'TEREX(THAILAND)LIMITED. 450'. Source counter: page claims 31,906 total shipments; rows actually visible on the free page = 5 shipment rows (plus 5 supplier rows and 5 buyer rows). Only 5 individual records were verifiable, not 31,906.
domestic_evidence: No domestic-supply evidence retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report India splits were not obtained: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, and web_search was unavailable during this run (searx connection refused), so no tender or GST page could be located. Note that the ImportKey rows above are customs (cross-border) records only and do not evidence domestic Indian sales. Domestic status is therefore 'unknown' — not 'none_found' — because the check could not be performed, not because absence was established.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs rows with B/L numbers exist for outbound India→Bhutan (B/L 1120941, HS 84749000, 2026-02-28) and India→Malaysia (B/L 1138224, HS 84829900, 2026-02-28), plus recurring buyer lanes to Thailand and Kenya. Caveat on direction: ImportKey's page mixes import and export records under one counter, and several of the largest counterparties (Terex Changzhou 6113, Terex Global GmbH 6236, NBC Group 1311) appear on the supplier side, i.e. inbound to India; the export direction is established by the specific rows quoted (India port of origin → foreign destination), not by the aggregate 31,906 figure. Declared HS 848230 (spherical roller bearings) is not contradicted but is not the code on the verified rows — observed codes are 84749000 (parts of sorting/screening machinery) and 84829900 (parts of bearings); per project rules this is not a rejection ground, only a code correction to the actual observed HS. Legal entity: Terex India Private Limited is the Indian manufacturing subsidiary of Terex Corporation (Hosur plant), but I did not independently verify CIN/PAN — those fields are null here as not retrieved. Revenue and export volume: null — ImportKey free view gives shipment counts, not values, and no financials were accessible. No rejection grounds apply.
